t: Virtual Desktops: Your Future-Proof Workflow in a World of Forced Upgrades
s: The article argues that mastering virtual desktops, a cross-platform feature, is crucial for future-proofing workflows against forced upgrades and proprietary system lock-in. The author shares their migration to NixOS as an example of breaking free from these constraints.
sub: The benefits and cross-platform compatibility of virtual desktops.
Critique of proprietary OS upgrade cycles (Windows, macOS) and their limitations.
NixOS as a solution for system reproducibility and freedom from dependency hell.
Platform-specific nuances and best practices for using virtual desktops.
The evolution and strengths of the GNOME desktop environment.
